rules.statement: When a District Judge orders that an intervenor must file a separate action to vindicate its rights, the dispute between the intervenor and the Public Trustee remains unresolved until finally decided.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) When the District Judge made order that the intervenient' s remedy is to file a separate action and vindicate his rights. the dispute between the intervenient and the Public Trustee remains until it is finally decided. (2) Hence the order will not finally dispose of the matter in dispute. The said order is not a judgment with the meaning of section 754(5)

rules.statement: An order that does not finally dispose of the matter in dispute is not a judgment within the meaning of section 754.
